name: Brazil (ABNT NBR 6118, 6120, 6123, 8681, 8800, 15421)
description: The Brazilian ABNT standards (alpha 9 track C24), a pack that extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22. Seismic by NBR 15421:2006: the characteristic ground acceleration ag of the seismic zones 0-4 (0.025-0.15 g), the site classes A-E with Ca and Cv (Table 3), ags0 = Ca ag and ags1 = Cv ag, the spectrum 2.5 ags0 from 0.08 Cv/Ca to 0.4 Cv/Ca and ags1/T beyond (the base pack's two-period form with SS = 2.5 ag, S1 = ag, Fa = Ca, Fv = Cv and no 2/3), Cs ≥ 0.01, the importance factors 1.0, 1.25, 1.5 and the R, Ω0, Cd of the systems (the base pack's ASCE 7 numbers, which NBR 15421 Table 6 shares). Wind by NBR 6123:1988: the basic speed V0 of the isopleths, Vk = V0 S1 S2 S3 with S2 = b Fr (z/10)^p of the terrain categories I-V (class B buildings), S3 the statistical factor of the use group and q = 0.613 Vk², by the generic speedFactors method. Load combinations by NBR 8681 (1.4G + 1.4Q, the wind combinations with ψ0, the exceptional seismic one). Concrete by NBR 6118:2014: γc 1.4, γs 1.15, the rectangular block 0.85 fcd over 0.8 x, x/d ≤ 0.45, Eci = 5600 √fck as Ecs, shear model I (Vc = 0.09 fck^(2/3) bw d, VRd2 = 0.27 αv2 fcd bw d, the stirrups on 0.9 d with fywd ≤ 435 MPa) by the generic partialFactors and tabulatedStress methods; bars Ø5-Ø40 (NBR 7480). Steel NBR 8800 as the base pack's AISC 360-22 (γa1 1.10 ≈ 1/φ 0.90). Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the towns' ag and V0 are uncertain and must be checked before design.
